info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Status API allows consumers to retrieve the current status of various rideshare rides. This endpoint serves as a central source for monitoring ride statuses, including active, completed, or canceled rides. Typical users of this API include rideshare applications, fleet management systems, and third-party developers looking to enhance user experiences with real-time data. By integrating this API, businesses can improve operational efficiency and provide timely updates to riders and drivers.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of rides.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of all rides. It provides information on whether rides are active, completed, or canceled, enabling better management and user experience.
